LESSON: READING 13.4.1 GRADE- APPROPRIATE PLAY: STYLE

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: ENGLISH
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.4: Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What is the role of humour in a play?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the styles of humour and monologue in a play
2. dramatise instances of humour and monologue in a play

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: READING 13.4.1 GRADE- APPROPRIATE PLAY: STYLE
This lesson teaches Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style for Grade 9 ENGLISH.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify the styles of humour and monologue in a play
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. dramatise instances of humour and monologue in a play
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style above.
2. Explain Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 13.4.1 Grade- appropriate Play: Style important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is the role of humour in a play?
2. Which programmes on radio or television do you find amusing?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the styles of humour and monologue in a play
2. dramatise instances of humour and monologue in a play
